help.subtitle: Finding games, picking favorites, and more
help.0.title: START PLAYING
help.0.body: CouchDoom reads the games you already have in DoomRunner, ZDL, or Doom Launcher, and leaves those setups as you made them. It can also show games found by GZDoom, UZDoom, or VKDoom. Pick a game and play.
help.1.title: CAN'T FIND YOUR GAMES?
help.1.body: CouchDoom usually finds your launcher automatically. If it finds more than one, choose the one you want. If your games still aren't listed, open the launcher picker and choose “Find it myself…” to browse for your launcher or game port. You can also drop its folder onto the CouchDoom window.
help.2.title: BROWSE THE LIST
help.2.body: The selected game stays highlighted while its artwork and details appear beside the list. Select a group heading to see its games and open or collapse it. You can also click the small marker beside a heading. Jumping to a folded group lets you open it again. On a group heading, the bottom hint expands or collapses every group.
help.3.title: SEARCH AND FAVORITES
help.3.body: Search by game or group name. Matching games stay visible even when their group is folded. Mark games as favorites to keep them together near the top of the list. The hints along the bottom show the controls for your keyboard or controller.
help.4.title: GAME DETAILS
help.4.body: A game may show its title art, music, description, or a readme. Some games include a colorful end screen called ENDOOM. Open the info sheet to see these extras when they're available.
help.5.title: MUSIC
help.5.body: CouchDoom plays menu music when the selected game provides it. If you don't hear any, that game may not include menu music.
help.6.title: IF SOMETHING DOESN'T WORK
help.6.body: Check that your launcher still opens the game on its own. If CouchDoom can't find a launcher, use “Find it myself…” in the launcher picker. If your system asks before opening CouchDoom for the first time, allow it only if you downloaded it from the official release.
help.7.title: REPORT A BUG
help.7.body: Choose Help & Feedback above to browse questions and bug reports or share a new one. Before posting, include what you were doing, what you expected, and what happened. Mention the CouchDoom version and game or launcher involved. A screenshot or short log excerpt can help; remove personal file paths before sharing.
help.8.title: ABOUT
help.8.body: CouchDoom is made by KrisEnigma. Thanks for using it!
